import { Controller, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { BullModule, InjectQueue } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';

interface AuditPayload {
  readonly entryId: string;
}

@Injectable()
class AuditService {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('remote-audit')
    private readonly auditQueue: Queue<AuditPayload, void, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-producer-only-remote-audit
  async log(entryId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.auditQueue.add('log-entry', { entryId });
  }
}

@Controller('audit')
class AuditController {
  constructor(private readonly audit: AuditService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(): Promise<void> {
    await this.audit.log('audit-1');
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [BullModule.forRoot({}), BullModule.registerQueue({ name: 'remote-audit' })],
  controllers: [AuditController],
  providers: [AuditService],
})
class AuditModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: producer-only');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
